Alex — thanks for sending this over. We received the PDF and see the amount and bank reference, but as you note there are no invoice-level references in the payment file. To reconcile on our side we need either: (1) invoice numbers or (2) a short allocation instruction.

For AcMetal we also need the VAT breakdown per invoice because several of their invoices include mixed VAT/non-VAT lines (EU reverse charge handling). Can you confirm whether VAT was included on the swept amount or whether AcMetal will separately account for VAT?

I've looped in our ledger team (Jonas) and payments (Laura & Vanessa) to run a provisional allocation and request a bank trace if needed. If ClearLane can procure a payer trace that shows the original payment instruction (payer reference), that would speed resolution.

Action items:
- Alex: please provide payer reference or bank trace if available.
- Jonas/Laura: see note below for provisional posting.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Manager, Revenue Operations — Redwood Inference
mina.haddad@redwood.com

Quick ledger export attached — I pulled unapplied credits and open invoices for AcMetal as of this morning. Based on matching the EUR amount and posting dates, suggested provisional allocations are:
- INV-2026-3112: EUR 21,400.00 (full)
- INV-2026-3113: EUR 19,750.00 (full)
- INV-2026-3118: EUR 7,608.00 (partial: EUR 7,607.90 applied, EUR 0.10 discrepancy)

The small 0.10 EUR difference looks like an internal bank rounding or fee. I flagged VAT status in the CSV — INV-3112 is standard VAT, INV-3113 is reverse-charge (no VAT on our side). See ledger_export_20261109.csv attached.

If ClearLane can confirm payer reference, we can make these postings final. Otherwise I'll park the unapplied balancing to suspense GL 2320 and record a suspense memo.

Attachment: ledger_export_20261109.csv (CSV, 6KB)

Regards,
Jonas
Senior AR Analyst — Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, ClearLane Finance <ap@clearlane.com>
Date: 2026-11-10T08:30:00Z
Subject: RE: Remittance advice — AcMetal 20261108

Following up after a quick bank trace request via our payments bank: attached is the trace output showing incoming value dates and an internal interbank fee of 0.10 EUR, posted by the clearing bank.

Conclusion: the 0.10 EUR rounding is a bank fee and should be booked to GL 6410 (bank fees). We can proceed with Jonas's allocations and post the delta to bank fees rather than leaving a suspense balance.

Attachment: bank_trace_20261110.txt (TXT, 3KB)

I'll hold final posting until we get a short confirmation from ClearLane that the payer reference is not available. If they can provide it later, we can reopen and remap accordingly.

Laura Bennett
Payments Lead — Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com

From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>

Subject: Allocation confirmation and remittance format request — AcMetal sweep

Hi Alex / Marta,

Thanks for the quick turn. Based on our internal checks (ledger export + bank trace) we will proceed with the following posting today:
- INV-2026-3112: EUR 21,400.00 (posted, VAT charged as per invoice)
- INV-2026-3113: EUR 19,750.00 (posted, reverse-charge — no VAT posted by Redwood)
- INV-2026-3118: EUR 7,607.90 (partial posted)
- Bank fee: EUR 0.10 (posted to GL 6410)

Total matches incoming EUR 48,758.90 + bank fee 0.10 = EUR 48,759.00 recorded on our books. Please note small rounding; we will not hold this to suspense.

Two requests to avoid repeat reconciliation work:
1) Please have ClearLane include invoice numbers in the remittance reference field going forward (single-line comma-separated is fine).
2) For EU customers with mixed VAT handling (some invoices reverse-charge), please provide a VAT breakdown in the remittance file or indicate which invoices include VAT. We have uploaded a short Redwood remittance template here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1AbcExampleRemitTemplate — can ClearLane adapt to that layout?

HubSpot note: HS-Record-987654 updated with allocation and attachments.

Marta — can you confirm you are OK with the postings above? Alex — can ClearLane confirm whether the payer will include invoice refs for the next scheduled sweep?

Thanks,
Mina
Manager, Revenue Operations — Redwood Inference
